answer.summary: Validates the structural and data integrity of a sales record string by checking for empty IDs, numeric formats, and valid date ranges. It counts the total number of validation errors found within the input string.
inputs: U#S: CHAR(120) - The raw input record string containing sales data.
outputs: U#F: FIXED BIN(15) - The total count of validation errors detected.

rules.text: Extract the ID from the first 16 characters of the input string.
If the extracted ID is empty, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'ID LEER'.
Validate that characters 17-18 of the input string are numeric; if not, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'TYP'.
Validate that characters 19-22 of the input string are numeric; if not, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'KATEGORIE'.
Validate that characters 63-73 of the input string represent a signed numeric value; if not, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'BETRAG'.
Validate that characters 83-86 of the input string are numeric; if not, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'MCC'.
Validate that characters 87-102 of the input string are numeric; if not, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'KARTE'.
Validate that characters 103-110 of the input string represent a valid date (via KBU00025); if invalid, increment the error counter and log a warning with message 'DATUM'.
